items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I'm Jane Julian... Is that how you pronounce it? [INTERVIEWEE] That's correct.

ctx.x: Well, I'm Jane Julian, and this is March 13, 1971, and I'm at Paul Barnes' home at 1770 North Doris-Newis Street. Is that how you pronounce it?
That's correct. Doris-Newis? Yes, that's correct.
